Performs investigation and data loss prevention, data manipulation, coordination of activities. Performs actions to address or mitigate risks and vulnerabilities. Reviews and defines controls.

Access Control (AC), Building Architecture, Customer Solutions, Disaster Recovery Planning, Information Security, Network Security, Physical Security, Risk Assessments, Security Technologies

Analytical Thinking, Effective Communications, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Information Security Technologies, IT Environment, IT Standards, Procedures & Policies, IT Systems Management, Knowledge of Organization, Problem Solving, Software Security Assurance

title: Virtual Design Construction Manager
description:

The Virtual Design Construction Manager will provide routine and non-routine Building Information Modeling (BIM) administration and coordination to assigned projects.   • Navisworks
  • Strong background in commercial construction, large project experience (hotels, hospitals, data centers, multi family,etc.) managing the VDC aspect.

title: Project Manager/Business Analyst
description:
Job title: Project Manager/Business Analyst
Location: Trenton, NJ (Hybrid)
Duration: 12 months

Note: Hybrid role requiring 3 days onsite / 2 days remote — No exceptions.
Job description:
Position Overview
This individual will balance program office priorities with development team execution, ensuring that requirements are clear, backlogs are streamlined, features are delivered on time, and bugs are resolved promptly.
Success in this role requires excellent communication, resilience, and the ability to transform competing demands into an actionable, well-managed roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary liaison between the program office, stakeholders, and development teams, ensuring alignment despite competing priorities.
  • Partner with developers to ensure requirements are clearly understood, features are developed, and bugs are fixed within agreed timelines.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and defect triage sessions.
  • Work closely with the program office to streamline and prioritize the product backlog, clarify requirements, and remove blockers.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, third-party vendors, and leadership for the flawless execution of projects.
  • Review vendor Statements of Work (SOWs) and provide recommendations and feedback to the CIO.
  • Prepare and manage project budgets; recommend adjustments where necessary.
  • Maintain and update project epics, user stories, and tasks in Jira, ensuring clarity and accountability.
  • Generate reporting and updates for the client and internal leadership.
  • Lead business analysis efforts for Phase 3 of the Student Longitudinal Data Systems project, including student and staff data collection requirements.
  • Conduct stakeholder meetings to gather, document, and validate requirements.
  • Translate business needs into actionable user stories for Agile delivery.
  • Evaluate business processes, identify gaps, and recommend improvements or solutions.
  • Demonstrate leadership across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) in both Agile and Waterfall environments.
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of combined experience in project management and business analysis supporting software development projects.
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC and Agile methodologies.
  • Proven ability to manage difficult stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and build consensus in challenging environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or similar project management tools, including backlog management and defect tracking.
  • Familiarity with testing tools and practices to support QA efforts.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and interpersonal skills for engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated success in vendor management and providing executive-level reporting.
Preferred Skills
  • Experience with Salesforce (CRM, Service Cloud, or custom applications).
  • Exposure to data warehousing and reporting tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau).
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services for hosting and data integration.
  • Prior experience in the education sector or with statewide longitudinal data systems is a plus.

  • Project Management & Business Analysis
  • Gathering, Documenting, and Analyzing Requirements
  • User Story Creation & Agile Delivery
  • Agile Methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Backlog Management (Jira or Similar Tools)
  • Stakeholder Communication & Management
  • Cross-Functional Team Collaboration
  • Risk Analysis & Mitigation
  • UAT & Test Case Development

  • Salesforce (CRM, Service Cloud, Custom Applications)

description:
Job Title: SAP Configuration Specialist
Location: Denver, Colorado
Duration: Full Time
Notes:
  • WHQ – 2 days WFH; TWTh in the office
  • Configuration experience in SAP

Description :
The primary purpose of the IT Lead Business Process Analyst position is to lead, design, develop/configure, test and implement and business software solutions that enable strong business operations at client. This position acts as the primary liaison to the internal stakeholder groups to analyze, document, communicate and validate business and system requirements to drive process improvement and business value through organization.

Your Day to Day:
  • Lead the development and enhancement of business software performance
  • Manage large, complex project budget, timelines, communications, and deliverables
  • Drive process improvements, understanding end-to-end business processes and integration points of systems
  • Design, configure, test and manage the change management process to implement necessary system updates.
  • Determine requirements and plan internal and external resources in developing and supporting software enhancements and modifications per established standards
  • Work with other process teams to implement integrated business solutions
  • May be required to perform other related duties as assigned

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 7 years of applied technical/configuration experience in SAP or other ERP system and/or manufacturing systems and technologies and a minimum of 7 years of experience working with the Procure to Pay function.
  • Strong organizational and leadership skills
  • Proven ability to indirectly manage internal and external resources while maintaining accountability for quality, cost and timely completion per business requirements
  • Effective project, budget, and cost management skills Proven technical/functional authority and technical mentor to others
  • Effective interpersonal, verbal, written and negotiation communication skills
  • Fundamental working knowledge of process manufacturing
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Moderate travel required (11 - 29 days per year)
  • Work environment is typical of an office setting

Key to Remember
  • Need an Experience SAP Configuration Specialist – need someone with more experience!! Strong technical background in SAP is very important!!
  • Deep technical configuration skills – as well to support the team from a technical perspective.
